TITLE: Poster Text: Keep Your Receipt
TEXT:
KEEP YOUR RECEIPT

Not for refunds.
For proof.

Proof that:
- you were there
- you bought yourself something small
- you participated in a day that tried to erase you

This is not consumer advice.
This is memory advice.

Tape it to your wall.
Write on the back:
"I existed on this date, and I did my best."
